name: wait_for_sms_code
description: Wait for the next SMS verification code that arrives on the user's iPhone (forwarded by Fwrd) and return it. Call this right after a website or app says it has texted a code. Returns the code, the full text, and when it arrived.

contains.description: Optional word the text must contain, such as the service's name, to skip codes from other services.

timeout_seconds.description: How long to wait, up to 120. Default 60.
